PartnershipPersonPlacement.name: PartnershipPersonPlacement
PartnershipPersonPlacement.description: Represents an individual's verified placement or participation delivered through a Partnership Agreement, linked to a specific program, and partner organization, including on-campus, research, internship, and employment experiences.

AccountId.description: The organization that's associated with the partnership placement.

ContactId.description: The learner that's associated with the partnership placement.

EndDate.description: The end date of the partnership placement.

Hours.description: The number of hours that the learner spends on the partnership placement.

IndicatorResultId.description: The indicator result that's associated with the partnershuip placement.

InvolvementGroupMemberId.description: The involvement group member that's associated with the partnershuip placement.

IsPlacementCounted.description: Indicates whether to include the partnership placement in institutional outcome metrics.

LastReferencedDate.description: The timestamp when the current user last accessed this record indirectly, for example, through a list view or related record.

LastViewedDate.description: The timestamp when the current user last viewed this record or list view. If this value is null, and LastReferenceDate is not null, the user accessed this record or list view indirectly.

Name.description: The name of the partnership placement.

Notes.description: The user-provided notes about the partnership placement.

OutcomeIndicatorId.description: The indicator assignment that's associated with the partnershuip placement.

OwnerId.description: The ID of the owner of this object.

PartnershipAgreementId.description: The partnership agreement that's associated with the partnership placement.

PersonEmploymentId.description: The person employment that's associated with the partnershuip placement.

PlacementDate.description: The date that the partnership placement was created.

ProgramId.description: The program that's associated with the partnership placement.

Source.description: Specifies the source of the partnership placement, for example, career fair.

StartDate.description: The start date of the partnership placement.

Status.description: Specifies the status of the partnership placement.

TimePeriodId.description: The time period that's associated with the partnership placement.

Type.description: Specifies the type of the partnership placement, for example, internship.

CollaborativeProvisionType.description: Specifies the collaborative provision arrangement that's associated with the placement.

CountryId.description: The country where the placement occurs.

CourseOfferingId.description: The course offering that's associated with the placement.

DurationType.description: Specifies the unit or method that's used to to quantify the duration of the placement.

HostIdentifier.description: The ID of the host organization that's associated with the placement.

HostIdentifierType.description: Specifies the type of the ID of the host organization that's associated with the placement.

MobilityScheme.description: Specifies the mobility scheme that's associated with the placement.

PartnerEngagementNumber.description: The engagement number that's used by the partner that previously returned the learner as part of a learning.

PartnerLearnerIdentifier.description: The learner ID that's used by the partner that returned the learner as part of a learning.

PartnershipPersonPlacement.accessRules: These fields are available only if United Kingdom Compliance and Configuration is turned on.
